sources.title: taesd: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: The model integrates with the diffusers library via the AutoencoderTiny class. You load it with AutoencoderTiny.from_pretrained ("madebyollin/taesd", torch_dtype=torch.float16) and swap it into any Stable Diffusion pipeline using the pipe.vae = assignment.
